judgment.rationale: Both endpoints are same-grain P3 Grade Key Competences under the merged 'P3 Mathematics' Grade node at identical rank 2 (P3), so no lower-to-higher developmental direction is available from coordinates, and neither statement's content presupposes the other. Substantively they are parallel measurement-in-context competences: one covers differentiating and exchanging Rwandan Francs (1Frw-5000Frw) with word problems involving addition and subtraction; the other covers weighing and comparing mass in kg with exercises and word problems involving mass measurements. The coherence is more than the generic shared wording ('word problems involving') flagged by token/trigram nomination: both require quantifying and comparing standard units and applying arithmetic operations to real-world word problems, making them complementary measurement applications that mutually reinforce rather than one enabling the other. Money (Frw) and mass (kg) are distinct content domains, so no dependency is asserted. Evidence limitation: both SFIs' source evidence is truncated (24 omitted evidence items each) and both carry upstream audit/merge context, so absent detail cannot be assumed; the parent Grade node is a merge of 14 repeated header cells and is context only.

Symmetric relatesTo is therefore the supported judgment.
